aa4d84bfe473c9cbb.prompt:
Your only job: wait for a T3 thread to finish and return its final reply verbatim. Do not do any other work, do not send it messages.
1) Call the t3-code tool t3_thread_wait with threadId "mcp:264d8ebd-3c43-41ad-82d9-32ee58bfa4a3" and timeoutMs 1800000. If it returns timedOut=true, call it again; repeat up to 16 times (8 hours).
2) When it returns a terminal status, call t3_thread_read with that threadId, view "messages", limit 3, maxCharsPerItem 20000 (use afterPosition to reach the newest items if needed) and take the LAST assistant message.
3) Answer with the line "STATUS: <status>" and then that message verbatim. If the tools fail, answer "WATCH_FAIL: <reason>".
